events.title: Next Fest, halfway: five languages, a four-hour stream, five keys to win
events.summary: Three days into Steam Next Fest. Thanks to everyone who landed in the fog this week. Here is where things stand. Five interface languages. The demo now plays in English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil) and Russian. Switch in Options. The store page is in those languages too. Spotted a wrong word? Tell me in the discussions, the tables get fixes before launch. A four-hour session to watch. RonEmpire played the full game from planetfall through the campaign: Colonize an Alien Plan

events.title: Free demo in Steam Next Fest, until 26 Oct
events.summary: Xenobiome Command is in Steam Next Fest this week. The free demo has the tutorial and the first six campaign maps, from planetfall to the flooded shelf. Demo saves carry into the full game. You land in the fog with one colonist. The purple fungus breeds alien packs, and they walk toward your Landing Zone. Explore the fog, claim ground area by area, keep the colony fed, and burn the fungus before the packs reach you. A map takes 10 to 30 minutes and saves when you quit.Mouse and keyboard, gamepad

events.title: The Steam demo is out
events.summary: What you're getting intoYour lander is down in the fog with one colonist and nobody coming to help. The purple fungus on the ground is alive, and it breeds alien packs that walk toward your landing site and take whatever they reach. If they take the landing site, the colony is lost. So you explore the fog, claim the ground under it, and send your wardens out to meet the packs before they arrive. Burn the fungus and it stops breeding.
